name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 7 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 7 hours starting 2025-08-28, at wavelengths from 1.91 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
